rules.statement: A court can dispose of a case on issues of law alone, even if no evidence has been taken, provided that the issue is clear and there are no disputed facts.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 147 of the Civil Procedure Code expressly enables the courts of first instance to dispose of a case on issues of law alone, and for that purpose to postpone the settlement of the issues of fact until after the issues of law have been determined."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 147 of the Civil Procedure Code
